title: You Think Repeating Notes Locks In Memory, Yet One Deep Question Quintuples Recall
description:
Repeating notes five times feels like real studying! Yet endless repetition leaves almost zero lasting memory! This is the true story of Robert Lockhart's Toronto memory test. Here is what went wrong with old study advice.
